method: Viewed all four references first, then all forty PNGs individually in the supplied candidate and capture order. Scores are holistic reference-calibrated judgments of each size pair, with weaker-size details retained. No source, implementation, identity, interaction, or prior-review evidence was used. Standalone preview banners and unchanged combat room, actors, and hand art were excluded from comparative judgments. Combat background scores describe the visible integration of the assessed overlays with their surroundings. Large type and continuation below a reading lip were treated as intentional; none was penalized merely for extending below the viewport. Nine requires the references' painted hand, not leadership within this set.

rest.worst_problem: The three upper-right result badges are visibly rectangular texture patches rather than fitted, shaped enamel plaques.

size_notes.1600x900: The fort portrait and candlelit cloth are convincing, but the broad purple heading has flat letter faces and the result patches have square edges.
size_notes.1280x800: The three visible choices remain readable; the heavy carved bottom rail feels oversized beside the fine choice frames and narrow badge text.

event.worst_problem: The title's uniformly flat lavender letters lose the carved interior depth of the reference title.

size_notes.1600x900: The lectern, moon crest, parchment and lit windows form a clear focal stage; the lower rail has a very large central carved flourish.
size_notes.1280x800: The story and first choice remain clear; the second choice meets a definite rail, but the thick ornamental fascia competes with the smaller lectern.

gameover.worst_problem: The right-hand final-deck rows have smooth black-to-purple gradient faces that look much less painted than the central memorial cabinet.

size_notes.1280x800: The card rules and explanation remain visible, with sensible wrapping; shiny list rows and rectangular record label still stand out against the worn architecture.

size_notes.1280x800: The first choice is clear and the second passes behind a recognizable lip; bright left-end metal and a nearly straight top edge still feel assembled.

shop.worst_problem: The market title's evenly outlined faces remain cleaner and more mechanically embossed than the reference lettering.

gameover.worst_problem: The final-deck rows on the right are smooth purple fields with too little wear beside the deeply textured memorial cabinet.

size_notes.1280x800: Owner captions remain readable and group placement is clear; dark cyan Strength still has less contrast and material presence than the other conditions.

rest.worst_problem: The title's lavender letter faces still need irregular highlights and deeper internal shading to match the reference's carved lettering.

event.worst_problem: The parchment meets the lower reading lip with a mostly straight abrupt transition that needs stronger recessed shadow and a more tangible paper edge.

size_notes.1600x900: The purple-and-gold rail's small central ornament is restrained; title faces have depth and the warm parchment is the clear focus.
size_notes.1280x800: The story and first choice remain clear, with continuation indicated at the rail; a thin line of the next choice close to the lip makes the recess look shallow.

gameover.worst_problem: The right deck rows need edge wear and localized lighting that follow their shaped rims, rather than relying mainly on a mottled purple face.

size_notes.1280x800: The statistic remains on one balanced line and the explanation wraps clearly; row grain is visible, but their thin outlines and uniform illumination still look flatter than the cabinet.

shop.worst_problem: The market title remains too evenly finished to match the irregular lavender enamel and deep carved edges of the reference logo.

winner_fixes: Rest, event, gameover and shop: give the large lavender title faces irregular pale edge glints, darker carved interiors and sparse worn marks; preserve their current size and hierarchy.
Combat-floaters, upper status groups: deepen the shaped dark support faces and add worn rim relief around the crisp coral and cyan words, with sufficient breathing room inside each silhouette.
Combat-floaters, upper-right Strength plaque: raise its cyan contrast toward the other positive conditions while retaining its readable local Butler owner caption.

Gameover, right final-deck list: add directional wear, inset edge shadows and restrained candle highlights that follow each row's shaped rim; retain the central card, explanation and full memorial hierarchy.

Event, lower parchment boundary: strengthen the narrow shadow immediately behind the fitted lip and paint a paper edge so the page reads as recessed into the lectern rather than cut off at a straight line.

Rest, event, gameover and shop lower rails: paint visible joints between end caps and adjoining uprights, and add subtle uneven edge lighting across the long spans without enlarging the central ornaments.

Rest, right choice fields: give the broad purple material more localized warm light near the icons and cooler recesses toward the far edges, matching the fort portrait's depth while keeping every line of text.
Shop, top title and lower fascia: finish their painted material to the same standard as the merchant frame and curtain while preserving the current three-card stage and hanging price tags.

grafts.idea: Use the especially crisp, relatively bright cyan treatment of the upper-right Strength word as the contrast target for the winner's muted condition, retaining the winner's support material.
Borrow the warm brown carved face beneath the reading lip as a restrained material cue linking the rail to the wooden lectern; retain the winner's purple accents and fitted end shapes.
Borrow only the richer sculpted leaf relief visible in the bottom rail, scaled into small end details; do not import its oversized central carving or rectangular outcome badges.
